view: PA frontal chest radiograph, erect (left-side marker "L" at image top-right, conventional orientation)
technical_quality: Adequate: full lung fields and costophrenic angles included, adequate inspiration (~9-10 posterior ribs), no significant rotation, adequate penetration with thoracic spine visible through the mediastinum. Large bilateral breast shadows overlie both lower zones; scapulae mostly projected clear of the lungs.

abnormalities.finding: Large well-circumscribed rounded mass-like opacity (~9 x 8 cm) in the right mid zone, extending from the right hilum/right cardiomediastinal border laterally toward the chest wall with a convex superior margin; silhouettes the right heart border (suggesting anterior/middle-lobe or hilar location). Aerated lung with vascular markings is seen below it in the right lower zone.
Unfolded, tortuous thoracic aorta with prominent aortic knob (age-related); mediastinum otherwise midline, trachea central.
Cardiac silhouette upper-normal to borderline enlarged; right heart border cannot be fully assessed because it is obscured by the right mid-zone mass.
Degenerative changes of both glenohumeral joints and thoracic spine; no rib fracture or destructive bone lesion identified.

description_zh: 正面站立胸部X光（PA），吸氣量尚可、無明顯旋轉，未見任何導管、引流管、手術夾或心律調節器等裝置。右側中肺野可見一約9公分之大型類圓形、邊緣尚清楚的腫塊狀緻密影，內側與右肺門及右心緣相連而使右心緣模糊，其下方右下肺野仍可見肺紋理；左肺清晰，雙側肋膈角大致銳利，未見氣胸或明顯肋膜積液。胸主動脈迂曲、主動脈弓突出，心影大小約在上限但因右側腫塊遮蔽難以完整評估；氣管居中。雙側肩關節及胸椎有退化性變化，左橫膈下可見較大的胃泡，雙側乳影重疊於下肺野。
